features.title: Print a phone sign-in QR for a trusted HTTPS origin
features.summary: At startup the Host prints one scannable QR per configured HTTPS origin, carrying the process launch token so a phone can exchange it for a persistent browser cookie.
failureModes: A non-HTTPS, credentialed, or non-absolute origin is ignored instead of printed.
Nothing is printed when the loader or Connection service is unavailable.

verification.reason: The Host prints to the terminal and renders no UI; the scratch Host boot check verifies the bundle loads and prints.

telemetry.reason: Printing to the already-open terminal is not a work unit; the plugin opens no network connection and spawns nothing.
